About_&_Key_Points:
About
Bharat Rasayan Ltd is engaged in manufacturing Technical Grade Pesticides and Intermediates used in the agro-chemical industry. It was incorporated in 1989.
[1]
Key Points
Product Portfolio
The company has a leading market position in many technical and intermediate products, including
Lambda Cyhalothrin Technical, Metaphenoxy Benzaldehyde, Metribuzine Technical, Thiamethoxam (Insecticides), Fipronil (Insecticides), etc.
It has also added new products like
Fluxametamide, Tolfenpyrad Technical, Diuron Technical, etc
. Top 10 products account for 66% of total sales.
